slices.focus: Kelli discovers a plain-language workplace communication podcast during her commute via Shawna.
slices.summary: Kelli attends a state billing association dinner with Shawna and discovers a no-jargon podcast about difficult workplace conversations. She integrates it into her commute rotation between 1990s country songs, finding that better words at the right moment help with the friction she's been feeling at work. Shawna becomes an episode curator for her.
